claims.text: Role in MS: gait problems may be treated w extended-release 4-aminopyridine (dalfampridine).
claims.quote: Problems with gait may be treated with extended-release 4-aminopyridine (dalfampridine).

claims.text: Dalfampridine ER (Ampyra) dose, walking in multiple sclerosis: 10 mg ER tablet PO twice daily, ~12 h apart; do not exceed.
claims.quote: The maximum recommended dosage of AMPYRA is one 10 mg tablet twice daily and should not be exceeded. Take doses approximately 12 hours apart.

claims.text: No added benefit >10 mg twice daily; adverse reactions incl seizures more frequent at higher doses.
claims.quote: There is no evidence of additional benefit at doses greater than 10 mg twice daily. Adverse reactions, including seizures, and discontinuations because of adverse reactions were more frequent at higher doses.

claims.text: Take w or w/o food; administer tablets whole — do not divide, crush, chew, or dissolve.
claims.quote: AMPYRA can be taken with or without food. Administer tablets whole; do not divide, crush, chew, or dissolve AMPYRA tablets.

claims.text: Missed dose: do not take double or extra doses.
claims.quote: If a dose is missed, patients should not take double or extra doses.

claims.text: Estimate CrCl b4 initiating and monitor at least annually during tx.
claims.quote: Estimated creatinine clearance (CrCl) should be known before initiating treatment with AMPYRA, and monitored at least annually during treatment with AMPYRA.
claims.locator: 2.3 Renal Monitoring Prior to and During Treatment

claims.text: Dalfampridine ER (Ampyra) CI: history of seizure.
claims.quote: History of seizure [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1)]

claims.text: CI: Hx of hypersensitivity to AMPYRA or 4-aminopyridine (incl anaphylaxis).
claims.quote: History of hypersensitivity to AMPYRA or 4-aminopyridine; reactions have included anaphylaxis

claims.text: Dalfampridine ER (Ampyra) warnings: Seizures: permanently discontinue and do not restart if a seizure occurs on tx.
claims.quote: Permanently discontinue AMPYRA in patients who have a seizure while on treatment.

claims.text: Mild renal impairment (CrCl 51–80 mL/min): plasma levels may approach those at 15 mg twice daily, ↑ seizure risk — weigh benefit vs risk.
claims.quote: In patients with mild renal impairment (CrCl 51–80 mL/min), AMPYRA plasma levels may approach those seen at a dose of 15 mg twice daily, a dose that may be associated with an increased risk of seizures

claims.text: ⍉ concomitant other forms of 4-aminopyridine (4-AP, fampridine) — same active ingredient.
claims.quote: Avoid concomitant use with other forms of 4-aminopyridine (4-AP, fampridine) since the active ingredient is the same.
claims.locator: 5.3 Concurrent Treatment with Other Forms of 4-Aminopyridine

claims.text: Anaphylaxis/severe allergic reactions: respiratory compromise, urticaria, angioedema of throat/tongue;
claims.quote: AMPYRA can cause anaphylaxis and severe allergic reactions. Signs and symptoms have included respiratory compromise, urticaria, and angioedema of the throat and or tongue.

claims.text: instruct pts to discontinue and seek immediate medical care if these occur.
claims.quote: Inform patients of the signs and symptoms of anaphylaxis and instruct them to discontinue AMPYRA and seek immediate medical care should these signs and symptoms occur.

claims.text: Dalfampridine ER (Ampyra) interactions and overdose: OCT2 inhibitors (e.g., cimetidine) may ↑ dalfampridine exposure;
claims.quote: Concurrent treatment with OCT2 inhibitors, such as cimetidine, may cause increased exposure to dalfampridine

claims.text: elevated levels ↑ seizure risk; weigh benefit of concurrent OCT2 inhibitors vs seizure risk.
claims.quote: Elevated levels of dalfampridine increase the risk of seizures [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1, 5.2) ]. The potential benefits of taking OCT2 inhibitors concurrently with AMPYRA should be considered against the risk of seizures in these patients.

claims.text: OD: seizure, confusion, tremulousness, diaphoresis, amnesia; some develop status epilepticus responsive to standard seizure therapy.
claims.quote: resulting in numerous adverse events including seizure, confusion, tremulousness, diaphoresis, and amnesia. In some instances, patients developed status epilepticus, requiring intensive supportive care and were responsive to standard therapy for seizures.
